body: Couldn't reproduce on Windows 10, maybe is platform related. @kylereinfeld coud you test if this bug is reproducible in Godot 4,5 and 4.4 stable?

I can replicate. MacOS Version 15.6.1 (24G90)

- Godot v4.6-dev6
- Godot v4.6-beta1
- Godot v4.6-beta2

Can not replicate on

- Godot v4.5-stable
- Godot v4.6-dev1
- Godot v4.6-dev3
- Godot v4.6-dev5

Seems to have been introduced between dev5 and dev6 of v4.6

Bisecting.

EDIT - I can only replicate on the downloaded templates from the engine archive, and can't replicate the bug on a _locally-compiled_ v4.6-dev6 or v4.6-beta2.

EDIT 2 - I can replicate with the following flags on the above versions:

```
scons platform=macos target=editor production=yes use_lto=yes debug_symbols=no use_static_cpp=yes generate_bundle=yes
```

```
5ff8f21ff3c9767666fc289fadeeee65e35840d1 is the first bad commit
commit 5ff8f21ff3c9767666fc289fadeeee65e35840d1 (HEAD)
Author: Rindbee <idleman@yeah.net>
Date:   Thu Dec 4 10:36:39 2025 +0800

    Fix the issue of no scan after dir creation and/or deletion
    
    When `EditorFileDialog` creates/deletes a directory during interactive
    operation, it needs to notify `EditorFileSystem` to scan and detect
    the filesystem change.

 editor/gui/editor_file_dialog.cpp | 21 +++++++++++++++++++++
```

Seems to be caused by calling `EditorFileSystem::get_singleton()->scan_changes();` with null `EditorFileSystem`, and for some reason not always crashing.
